__broaden__.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’ · also masc. gen. sg. in a genitive absolute, of a stream: ’it’ (τοῦ … προρέοντος ’as it flows forward’) · also masc. gen. sg. of cause: ’on his account’ (τοῦ δὴ νῦν … φέρεις χάριν ’it is on his account that you bring favour’) · also masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute with ἑλκομένοιο: ’as he was dragged’ (τοῦ δ’ ἦν ἑλκομένοιο κονίσαλος) · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, after ἑκάτερθεν: ’of it’ (τοῦ ἑκάτερθεν ’on either side of it’)
__broaden__.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a participle: ’the (man) who’ (τὸν προὔχοντα ’the one ahead’) · also masc. acc. sg., article-like with an adjective and noun: ’the’ (τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον ’the right-hand horse’) · also τὸν ἑόν, ’his own’ (τὸν ἑόν … Πόδαργον ’his own Podargus’)
__broaden__.ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as, as far as; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’as far as’ · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial, of measure: ’about as much as’ (ὅσον τ’ ὄργυι’ ’about a fathom’)
